_note: Founder's good default Stage-0 config (Tom 2026-06-14, re-tuned gaps). The shape the real Stage-0 player should read. These gaps are the FOUNDER DEFAULTS that gle/hrv/spa/deu fall back to; jpn carries a per-example override. Known-side audio uses an xAI English voice ('leo'). Audio is 192k mono single-encode (decode→WAV, all DSP in PCM, one mp3 encode — never re-encode in place / never 48k) and loudness-normalised (EBU R128, ~-16 LUFS, TP ≤ -1 dBTP). In the explainer tier, each 'means + gloss' is ONE continuous leo take with a recorded pause (no same-voice splice); beforeMeans stays a live cast→leo gap, afterMeans is the baked internal pause. Tuner: ~/Desktop/stage0-tuner.html. See docs/pods/stage0-explainer-ladder-SPEC.md.
